content.user_title: Add Stripe Payments to Caffeine AI Apps
content.value_statement: Caffeine AI apps need a reliable Stripe checkout flow with backend authorization and status handling. This skill provides Motoko and frontend guidance for configuring Stripe, creating checkout sessions, and routing payment outcomes.
actual_capabilities: Defines Stripe configuration, shopping item, checkout session, and session status types for Motoko backends.
Shows backend functions for admin-only product management and Stripe configuration.
Creates checkout sessions with success and failure URLs built from the current app origin.
Guides frontend JSON parsing, session URL validation, and Stripe redirect handling.
Specifies payment success and payment failure routes for TanStack Router.
Explains when to show an admin Stripe setup flow.
limitations: Requires the authorization extension before the Stripe integration can be added.
Assumes the app already has product data and frontend routing structure.
Does not cover refunds, disputes, subscriptions, or webhook processing.
Requires the developer to provide valid Stripe credentials and country settings.

use_cases.title: Add Checkout to a Caffeine AI Store
use_cases.description: Use the skill to add Stripe checkout sessions, redirect handling, and result pages to a product app.

use_cases.title: Create Admin Payment Setup
use_cases.description: Build an admin flow that checks Stripe configuration and stores required settings before checkout is enabled.

use_cases.title: Review Payment Flow Requirements
use_cases.description: Compare an existing app against the required backend functions, checkout hook behavior, and payment routes.

prompt_templates.title: Add Basic Checkout
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new Caffeine AI app.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to add Stripe checkout to my Caffeine AI app. Include backend configuration, checkout creation, and payment result routes.

prompt_templates.title: Build Payment Setup UI
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Stripe setup flow for admins. It should check whether Stripe is configured and request the secret key and allowed countries only when needed.

prompt_templates.title: Connect Product Checkout
prompt_templates.prompt: Integrate my product list with the Stripe checkout flow. Map selected items to shopping items and validate the returned session URL before redirecting.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Payment Integration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of an existing implementation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Caffeine AI Stripe implementation against this skill. Check authorization, configuration handling, checkout session creation, redirect behavior, and result routes.

output_examples.input: Add Stripe payments to a Caffeine AI storefront.
output: Backend exposes admin-only Stripe configuration and checkout session creation.
Frontend validates the checkout session URL before sending the user to Stripe.
The app includes success and failure routes for payment outcomes.

output_examples.input: Check whether my Stripe setup flow is complete.
output: The admin view checks configuration status before showing setup fields.
The setup flow collects the secret key and allowed country list.
Checkout is blocked until valid Stripe configuration exists.
The session result must be parsed before redirecting.
The redirect must stop when the session URL is missing.
External Stripe navigation should use the browser location instead of router navigation.

best_practices: Install and configure the authorization extension before adding Stripe payment functions.
Restrict Stripe configuration changes to admin users only.
Validate every checkout session URL before redirecting the browser.
anti_patterns: Do not show Stripe secret key setup after configuration is complete.
Do not redirect to a missing or undefined session URL.
Do not use internal router navigation for an external Stripe checkout URL.

faq.question: What does this skill add?
faq.answer: It adds guidance for Stripe configuration, checkout session creation, payment redirects, and payment result routes in Caffeine AI apps.

faq.question: Does it require another extension?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill says to follow the authorization extension first because payment setup depends on admin permissions.

faq.question: Where is the Stripe secret key configured?
faq.answer: The backend exposes an admin-only configuration function. The frontend setup flow asks admins for the Stripe secret key when needed.

faq.question: How does checkout redirect work?
faq.answer: The frontend creates a checkout session, parses the result, validates the session URL, and redirects the browser to Stripe.

faq.question: Which frontend router is expected?
faq.answer: The skill expects TanStack Router for the payment success and payment failure routes.

faq.question: Does this cover Stripe subscriptions?
faq.answer: No. The skill focuses on checkout sessions for payments and does not provide a subscription workflow.
